author: mark
text:
await: detect kill-mid-stream subagents via /proc fd scan

Closes the v0.4 P3 follow-on. The shipped await detected `stopped`
only via the §4.4 `error` event; this lands the other §2.9 signature
— response.json closed without `message_stop` and without `error`.
Implemented by reusing the §2.9 / line-267 ProcFsFinder /proc fd
scan that drives `lernie stop` pid discovery — same source of truth
the §3.5 in_flight classification reads. No new dependency, no
inotify watcher thread; PRINCIPLES.md "Single source of truth"
preserved. Linux-only on the kill arm; the error arm is portable.

Updates ARCHITECTURE.md §765 and skills/await/SKILL.md to document
both stopped signatures. 100% coverage maintained.
